其他：
另外，最新版 1.1 空间超分辨率模型可在此处获取：
https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.3/tree/main

小型变分自编码器（taeltx2_3.safetensors）下载地址：
https://huggingface.co/Kijai/LTX2.3_comfy/blob/main/vae/taeltx2_3.safetensors

Realistic film style, cinematic automatic camera movement, high definition, consistent characters, scenes and props, Identify different characters in the audio file based on reference images and prompts, and synchronize mouth shapes for each character，Generate sound effects and BGM correctly according to prompts.

The man on the right knocks on the door and walks up to the table. Then the seated man on the left speaks first | Push the camera closer to the man on the right ，he talks angrily. After the man finish his words,the camera pan to the laser figure in the middle of the reference picture, which flashes a red alert and emits a shrill alarm sound simultaneously.
